issues.description: The problem statement's example initializer for Course shows parameters in the order (instructor: , name: , ratings: ), but both the template and the solution define the initializer as init(name: String, instructor: String, ratings: [Int]). This mismatch between the shown usage and the actual initializer signature can confuse students who copy the example call and then get a compiler error or unexpected parameter ordering.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the initializer example in the problem statement match the template/solution signature, e.g. change the example to: let course = Course(name: "My Course", instructor: "My Instructor", ratings: []). Alternatively, change the template and solution initializer to init(instructor: String, name: String, ratings: [Int]) if the intent was to show instructor first — but the simpler fix is to correct the problem statement example to match the existing code.
